Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1480
Claimant:
Rachel Stark
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
12/16/2023
Claim received for a hit while turning left at an intersection. The insured reports the other vehicle struck the rear
quarter as the claimant was completing a left turn. Claimant is not represented by counsel.
12/26/2023
Verified that the driver is named on the policy and that coverage was in force at the time of loss. Nothing in the file
suggests the damage predates the policy start.
02/28/2024
Spoke with the claimant by phone. The account of the turn and the point of impact matched the first statement given
at the scene, with no changes in sequence or detail.
03/04/2024
Police report and two responding officers confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the scene. No independent
witnesses were located to the collision itself.
05/15/2024
Reviewed photos submitted by the claimant. They confirm the general location of the impact and the damaged
panels. Damage pattern is largely consistent with the described angle of impact.
05/27/2024
Checked prior claim history on the vehicle. No earlier damage to the same areas is on record, and no prior repairs
were reported.
06/30/2024
Claimant reports neck and shoulder pain beginning shortly after the collision, with a shoulder injury noted at the first
medical visit. The reported injury is plausible for a collision of this type.
07/12/2024
Medical records show the claimant had a small strain in the same shoulder area several years ago that healed fully.
Treatment this time followed a typical course and tapered off as the claimant improved.
07/23/2024
Claim reviewed for next steps. Account has been consistent across all contacts, the damage and injury are in line
with the impact described, and the file is ready for settlement evaluation.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
